info.title: LastDB app API
info.description: The app API lastdbd serves today: POST /v1/read, POST /v1/write, and POST /v1/x/<name>. info.version is the node api_version. Extensions carry no version: adding one does not change api_version, and removing one is refused. The app socket accepts a request body of at most 8388608 bytes. The owner socket does not use that cap. On the app socket a whole-request refusal uses the error object. A read that fails one item returns HTTP 200 and puts the same error object in that item.

x-lastdb-launcher-environment.LASTDB_SOCKET_PATH: Absolute path of the app socket, apps.sock, under the node home. The launcher sets this without calling the node.
x-lastdb-launcher-environment.LASTDB_APP: The app id from the installed receipt. The app sends it as the X-LastDB-App header. POST /api/apps/register echoes the app id it was sent, and install sends this id.
x-lastdb-launcher-environment.LASTDB_APP_DATA: The app data directory, <apps root>/<app>/data. It stays in place across an upgrade and a launch. The grant records this path at install.
x-lastdb-launcher-environment.TMPDIR: Temporary directory the launcher creates at LASTDB_APP_DATA/tmp.

post.summary: Read records or keys. Each item returns its own result or its own error.

200.description: One result per read, in order. An item error is inside this body, not an HTTP error.

post.summary: Apply conditional mutations. The list commits all or nothing.

200.description: The list is on disk. revisions follows request order.

post.summary: Read the numbered list of changed record keys. This extension has no version.

200.description: A page of change entries, or a head with no entries.

post.summary: List and create databases, place a schema, and use a whole-database share. This extension has no version.

200.description: The owner route's success JSON for every action except submit.

202.description: submit accepted the proposal into the share's pending log. The node did not write a record.

app.name: X-LastDB-App
app.description: Required on the app socket. The value is the app id. An app id the node has no grant for is permission_denied. The owner socket does not require this header. The root security list allows either socket.

Error.description: Whole-request refusal. Status 422 is returned as 400, 401 as 403, and 423 and 429 as 503. Status 500 replaces message with "internal error". Status 507 stays 507 and its code is internal.

DatabaseName.description: 1 to 64 bytes: ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, and underscore. With no database session, omit the field to use the personal database. On a request that carries X-LastDB-Database-Session, omit the field to address that session's database. An item that names a different database is permission_denied and its message is "a database session addresses only its own database". An unknown identifier is not_found and its message is "database is not registered on this node". A received database can be read. A write to one is permission_denied because a received database is read only. /v1/x/changes does not serve a received database, and a database session cannot call it.

SchemaName.description: Schema name. On the app socket the name must be exact. On the owner socket a loose form can resolve. An empty name is refused on changes.

KeyInput.description: Primary or alternate key on a request. hash and range may be omitted. A null field is accepted. A keyed read requires a non-empty hash.

Key.description: Key on a reply. Both fields are present. Each is a string or null. A key-list hash is a string, possibly empty. A key-list range is null when the record has no range.

RangePrefix.description: Ranges under one hash that start with prefix.

RangeBounds.description: Ranges under one hash from start through end.

Range.description: One of the three range forms. Any other combination is invalid_request on that read item. JSON null for prefix, start, or end is treated as absent by the parser and is not one of these forms.

ReadByKey.description: A read by one key. A keyed read accepts limit 0. The page default is 100. A limit above 1000 is capped at 1000 and is not rejected. The cursor is URL-safe base64 with no padding.

via.description: Alternate key name. Omit it to use the primary key.

limit.description: Page size. Omit it for 100. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000.

cursor.description: Opaque token from next_cursor of the previous page.

keys_only.description: Return keys instead of records. Omit it for false.

file.description: When true, each record file includes path. Omit it for false. On the owner socket, file_dir names the folder that path is written into.

file_dir.description: Owner socket only. Absolute path of a directory that exists, is owned by the calling user, and is not group or world writable. Requires file. The node writes a held file there as the content hash, mode 0600, and returns that path. Refused on the app socket.

ReadByRange.description: A read by one of the three range forms. A range read accepts limit 0. The page default is 100. A limit above 1000 is capped at 1000 and is not rejected. The cursor is URL-safe base64 with no padding.

via.description: Alternate key name. Omit it to use the primary key.

limit.description: Page size. Omit it for 100. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000.

cursor.description: Opaque token from next_cursor of the previous page.

keys_only.description: Return keys instead of records. Omit it for false.

file.description: When true, each record file includes path. Omit it for false. On the owner socket, file_dir names the folder that path is written into.

file_dir.description: Owner socket only. Absolute path of a directory that exists, is owned by the calling user, and is not group or world writable. Requires file. The node writes a held file there as the content hash, mode 0600, and returns that path. Refused on the app socket.

ReadKeyList.description: Lists the primary keys of the schema. The node returns invalid_request on that item inside HTTP 200 when limit is 0. The page default is 100. A limit above 1000 is capped at 1000 and is not rejected. The cursor is a storage key. via, file, and file_dir are not properties of this form. The node also returns that item error when a key list sets them.

keys_only.description: Must be true. This form lists primary keys.

limit.description: Page size. Omit it for 100. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Zero is invalid_request on this item.

cursor.description: Opaque storage key from next_cursor of the previous page.

ReadWithoutKey.description: No key and no range, and keys_only is absent or false. The node accepts this shape and returns invalid_request on that item inside HTTP 200. A read of records still names a key or a range.

via.description: Alternate key name. With no key and no range the node returns invalid_request on this item.

limit.description: Page size. This form does not run a read.

cursor.description: Opaque token. This form does not run a read.

keys_only.description: Must be false when present. Omit it for the same item error.

file.description: When set with no key and no range, the node returns invalid_request on this item.

file_dir.description: When set with no key and no range, the node returns invalid_request on this item. On a keyed read it is owner-socket only and requires file.

ReadItem.description: One read. A key and a range together match none of these forms. The node still parses that combination and returns invalid_request on that item inside HTTP 200. A key list that also sets via, file, or file_dir does the same and also matches none of these forms. A keyed cursor is URL-safe base64 with no padding. A key-list cursor is a storage key. Both are opaque strings.

reads.description: At least one read and at most 64. An empty list or a longer list is HTTP 400.

FieldValues.description: Field names and JSON values defined by the schema. This file cannot list them.

FileInfo.description: Present when the record has a file. name and media_type are null when the marker has none. size is the byte length. local is the path on this device, or null when this device does not have the bytes. path is present only when the read set file to true: a string when this device has the file, null when LastDB holds the bytes and there is no folder to place them. On the app socket that folder is the grant's data folder. On the owner socket it is file_dir. Other properties are allowed.

Record.description: One record. file is null when the record has no file.

next_cursor.description: Null when this is the last page. Otherwise an opaque cursor.
Null when this is the last page. A schema key list uses a storage key. A keyed read uses URL-safe base64.

Error.description: code and message are always present. index is present when a write refusal concerns one mutation. reason is present when a write condition failed. Both are omitted on status 500. Other properties are allowed. A structured node error is placed in message as text; the reply does not keep the original JSON.

x-lastdb-status-codes.500: internal. message is replaced with "internal error".
x-lastdb-status-codes.503: busy. Status 423 and 429 are returned as 503.
x-lastdb-status-codes.507: internal. The status stays 507 and the storage message is kept.

index.description: Zero-based position of the mutation this write refusal concerns. Omitted when the refusal is not about one mutation.

reason.description: Why a write condition failed. exists: a create found a record. absent: a replace or a delete found none. revision: the record is at another revision. The message is mutation <index>: followed by one sentence for that reason, or the sentence alone when index is omitted.

ReadResult.description: A records page, a keys page, or one item error.

results.description: One entry per request item, in order.

FileLink.description: A regular file outside the LastDB home. The request carries no bytes. A path the node cannot link is invalid_request, and the message does not say whether the path exists.

AlternateValue.description: An alternate address, or null to clear that alternate on create or replace.

Alternates.description: Alternate key name to a key. Names come from the schema, so they are not listed here. A delete must send an empty object or omit the field; the node loads the stored alternates.

WriteCreate.description: A create. It carries a record and no revision. A revision on a create is HTTP 400.

WriteReplace.description: A replace. It carries a record and the revision it replaces. A replace without a revision or without a record is HTTP 400. A file path links that file. JSON null clears the record's file, and the node frees the bytes when no record names them. Omitting file keeps the record's file.

file.description: A path links that file. JSON null clears the record's file. Omitting the field keeps the record's file.

WriteDelete.description: A delete. It carries the revision it deletes, no record, and no file. alternates is omitted or empty. The node loads the stored alternates. A record, a file, or a non-empty alternates object is HTTP 400.

alternates.description: Omit this field or send an empty object. A non-empty object is HTTP 400.

WriteItem.description: One mutation: a create, a replace, or a delete. The node refuses a list that breaks those shapes with HTTP 400 and sets error.index. A condition that does not hold is HTTP 409. reason is exists, absent, or revision.

WriteRequest.description: Every mutation names the same database. The list commits all or nothing. An empty list is HTTP 400.

written.description: The number of mutations committed. Equal to the length of revisions.

revisions.description: The new revision of each mutation, in request order.

seq.description: Rises by one per changed record, in commit order.

ChangesRequest.description: after defaults to 0, not to the oldest kept entry. The node keeps the newest 250000 entries. The oldest kept number is head - 250000 + 1, and at least 1. gap is true when after is above head, or when after + 1 is below that oldest number. When head is greater than 250000, after 0 is a gap and the reply has no entries. limit defaults to 500 and a larger value is capped at 500. limit 0 returns the head and no entries. An empty schemas list means every schema on the owner socket. On the app socket it means every schema when the app's read grant is *, and only the named schemas otherwise. An app whose read grant names nothing gets permission_denied. A schemas filter still limits the entries. An empty schema name is invalid_request.

after.description: Return entries numbered above this value. Omit it for 0.

limit.description: Most entries to examine. Omit it for 500. Values above 500 are capped at 500.

schemas.description: Schema names to keep. Omit it or send an empty array for the default filter described above.

id.description: sha256 hex of changes:<stream>. It changes when a restore replaces the database.

head.description: Newest number in the list. Zero means no entry.

through.description: Last number this read examined. The reader saves it as after on the next read.

DatabaseSelector.description: 1 to 64 bytes: ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, and underscore. Omit the field, or send JSON null, to use the personal database. A bad value is invalid_request and its message is invalid database identifier. An unknown identifier is not_found and its message is database is not registered on this node. list, create, and accept do not take this field.

DatabasesRetention.description: ttl_days or ttl_seconds, not both. It sits beside schema, not inside it.

DatabasesWriteSchemas.description: Definition ids, schema names, or every schema.

expectedRevision.description: Decimal revision the caller last read.

DatabasesSchema.description: The schema object the owner declare-schema route parses. name is required. Other fields are that object's fields.

DatabasesMutation.description: The mutation document POST /api/databases/{id}/submissions parses. Its tag is type and the value is mutation. This extension does not write the record.

DatabasesCreateRequest.description: POST /api/databases. A present Idempotency-Key header is forwarded. It is a v4 UUID only when sharingMode is whole_database. Any other present key is invalid_request.

DatabasesAcceptRequest.description: POST /api/databases/accept. This action has no database field. The owner body names database_id.

DatabasesDeclareRequest.description: On the app socket app_id is the calling app and the body must not carry app_id. On the owner socket app_id is required. The schema name must be one the app write grant allows. * allows every schema.

DatabasesSubmitRequest.description: POST /api/databases/{id}/submissions. idempotency_key becomes the Idempotency-Key header. The node appends the proposal to the pending log and does not write a record.

DatabasesRequest.description: One action. A field from another action is invalid_request.

DatabasesDatabaseReply.description: create and accept. database is the owner row.

DatabasesShareUpdateReply.description: The owner share configuration write envelope.

DatabasesInviteReply.description: The owner invitation envelope. invitation is the base64 sealed invitation.

DatabasesReply.description: Success JSON for an action other than submit. submit answers 202.

AllSchemas.description: Every schema on the node. It names none of them. A listing may carry it only at API version 38 or above, because an older build that cannot parse it fails the whole registry list for that channel and API version.

ManifestSchemaSide.description: Schema names the app asks for, or * for every schema.

ManifestAccess.description: The access block a developer writes in the app manifest. Publish reads read, write, and extensions and ignores any other key. read and write are each a list of schema names or the string *. A schema name is 1 to 128 characters of ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, slash, or hyphen. An extension name is 1 to 40 characters of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or underscore. A name that breaks those rules fails publish with one generic message. The schema entry itself is not defined here.

read.description: Schemas the app reads. * means every schema and names none.

write.description: Schemas the app writes. * means every schema and names none. It does not grant read.

extensions.description: Extension names the app calls. The list is not limited to changes and databases. Install refuses a name this build cannot grant. This build grants changes and databases. * is not a value here.

DefinitionMap.description: Schema name to the definition id of the one version the app was built against. At most 256 entries. A name is 1 to 128 characters of ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, slash, or hyphen. A definition id is 64 lowercase hex characters.

ListingSchemaSide.description: Schema name to definition id, or * for every schema. The map form is the same JSON object as before API version 38.

ListingAccess.description: The access block on the signed listing. Publish replaces each schema name with that name and its definition id. The string * stays * and means every schema. A listing may carry * only at API version 38 or above. Unknown keys are rejected.

read.description: Schemas the app reads, or * for every schema.

write.description: Schemas the app writes, or * for every schema.

extensions.description: Extension names. An extension name is 1 to 40 characters of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or underscore. Unknown names fail install. This build grants changes and databases.
